name: Baglioni Resort Maldives
positioning: All-inclusive island resort in the Dhaalu Atoll, officially Baglioni Maldives, with beach and overwater villas that blend traditional Maldivian architecture with Italian touches, a 45-minute seaplane flight from Velana International Airport
best_for: Couples who want an all-inclusive stay with Italian and Japanese restaurants on the island
Families who want a two-bedroom beach villa with a private pool and a first dive experience for children
Divers and snorkelers keen on reef dives and a whale shark excursion

facts.text: The resort is in the Dhaalu Atoll in the Maldives.
The resort operates on an all-inclusive basis.
The Beach Villa is set directly on the beach, surrounded by tropical vegetation, a few steps from the sea.
The Grand Baglioni Maldives Villa has three bedrooms and panoramic terraces overlooking the ocean.
Fuego is a beachside barbecue serving grilled meat and fish at sunset.
Taste offers a daily international selection, with evenings devoted to Indian Ocean and Middle Eastern traditions.
A Pizza Boat serves freshly baked pizza by the pool or seaside from a specially crafted oven.
A children's diving experience with a certified instructor goes to a maximum depth of 2 meters.
The resort has the Baglioni Aura Spa.
The resort holds Green Globe Certification.

highlights.text: Water Villas sit on stilts over the resort lagoon, linked to the island by a raised wooden walkway.
La Limonaia serves Southern Italy-inspired fine dining in an oceanfront setting.
The resort offers a whale shark snorkeling excursion in the Dhaalu Atoll.
In-villa dining is available from 6:00 am to midnight, with meals included in the all-inclusive plan.
The Two Bedroom Family Beach Villa With Pool has two bedrooms, direct beach access and a private pool, designed for families.

considerations.text: Guests reach the resort by a 45-minute seaplane flight from Velana International Airport.
International flights and transfers are not included; guests book flights to Velana International Airport on Male Island.
Floating breakfast is not included in the all-inclusive plan.
